Trunk: motion.path cubic bezier M400,650 C380,550 410,450 400,350 stroke #92400e width 18, animated pathLength 0→1 delay 1.1s duration 1.2s. Roots: 5 hardcoded motion.path Q beziers from (400,650) spreading outward, pathLength staggered from 0.3s. Branch count = Math.min(6,Math.max(3,Math.floor(treeData.total_leaves/6))). Branches: compute angle from lookup table {3:[-65,0,65], 4:[-65,-20,20,65], 5:[-70,-35,0,35,70], 6:[-70,-42,-14,14,42,70]}, attach point along trunk, length=60+(i*37%40), quadratic bezier, stroke #4ade80 width 4, animated staggered from 2.3s. Sub-branches: 2 per major branch, smaller scale, staggered from 3.5s. Leaves: map each leaf item from treeData.branches to SVG ellipse rx=12 ry=18 at sub-branch endpoint + offset, color by category {ecology:'#16a34a',uses:'#d97706',research:'#6366f1',conservation:'#ef4444',geography:'#0ea5e9',news:'#f59e0b'}, animated opacity+scale spring staggered from 4.5s with 0.08s between leaves, onClick calls onLeafClick(leafData), whileHover scale 1.4. Seed: motion circle at (400,650) opacity 0→1 at t=0.
